Choose a name the way real name diversity actually works -- varied, and not mechanically predictable from any single demographic field below.

Do not name specific real companies, real plan names, or real places beyond a generic reference to living in Maricopa County, Arizona.

response.backstory: Eleanor Mercer is an 88-year-old retired university administrator living in Maricopa County, Arizona, with comfortable retirement savings and no Medicaid eligibility. She is satisfied with her current Medicare Advantage plan and longstanding provider relationships, and she prefers familiar routines over the uncertainty of switching. Most days involve light exercise, reading, and regular check-ins from a nearby daughter who helps coordinate appointments and technology. In a plan, Eleanor values simplicity, dependable care coordination, caregiver support, and uninterrupted access to the clinicians she trusts more than minimizing her premium.
